descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Construcții, Dezvoltare de software și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Our client is a leading European online car marketplace, connecting car buyers and sellers across the continent. The platform serves over 30 million monthly users and operates across 18 countries, making it one of the largest and most trusted digital marketplaces for vehicles in Europe.
We’re looking for backend-focused .NET engineers who can quickly contribute to an existing codebase and take ownership of features through to production.
 Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain .NET-based integration services and microservices supporting the Workday-to-Data-Lake and Marketplace-to-HubSpot initiatives.
Develop, deploy, monitor, and operationally support cloud solutions on AWS, ensuring secure configuration throughout.
Implement robust API integrations covering authentication, data contracts, pagination/batching, rate limits, retries, error handling, and idempotent processing.
Build event-driven and asynchronous integration flows, including webhooks, scheduling, historical loads, and incremental data feeds.
Ensure data quality and reconciliation across integration pipelines, with clear source-of-truth ownership and secure handling of financial and operational data.
Partner with the squad's Tech Lead and team members to align with the existing reference architecture, priorities, and delivery plans.
Produce clear technical documentation and actively share knowledge within the engineering team.
Maintain skill overlap with the second integration engineer across both solutions to ensure delivery continuity.
 Requirements:
Strong experience with C# and .NET / ASP.NET Core.
Experience designing, building, and maintaining microservices and distributed systems.
Solid understanding of event-driven architecture, asynchronous messaging, and event-based integrations.
Experience building and integrating REST APIs, plus familiarity with relational databases and ORMs such as Entity Framework Core.
Comfort working with AI coding agents as part of day-to-day development.
Ability to work independently, contribute constructively to technical decisions, and balance maintainability with delivery speed.
Strong collaboration, documentation, and knowledge-sharing skills within an established engineering team; excellent verbal and written English skills (B2+ level).
 Nice to have:
Web frontend experience, ideally with Vue and TypeScript, and the ability to deliver features end-to-end.
Experience with AWS services such as ECS, SNS, SQS, and RDS, or equivalent cloud services.
Familiarity with CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, or domain-driven design.
 We offer*:
Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
A competitive salary and good compensation package
Personalized career growth
Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
Education reimbursement
Memorable anniversary presents
Corporate events and team buildings
Other location-specific benefits
not applicable for freelancers
